error_conditions.name: unsupported_wrap
error_conditions.handling: Reject at AXI admission with DECERR.

error_conditions.name: chi_response_error
error_conditions.handling: Retire the corresponding AXI R/B with SLVERR.

error_conditions.name: write_protocol_error
error_conditions.trigger: CompDBIDResp completion occurs before all required W/TXDAT activity
error_conditions.handling: Record protocol error and return SLVERR; do not synthesize success.

error_conditions.name: unknown_chi_transaction
error_conditions.trigger: RXDAT/RXRSP TxnID/opcode has no matching child
error_conditions.handling: Consume flit so shared RX FIFO cannot deadlock; do not mutate a context.

mismatches.description: Specification requires normal power-down drain, but the visible RTL interface has no quiesce/link-down request or drain-complete signal and kLinkDrain has no transition.
mismatches.recommendation: Specify the control interface and AXI behavior during drain before implementing or verifying this transition.

mismatches.description: The supplied structure-extraction script requires Python 3; this environment exposes only Python 2 as /usr/bin/python.
mismatches.recommendation: Use a Python 3 environment for automated extraction; this testplan uses a manually reviewed RTL structure meanwhile.
